children: Apple's
new lineup of smartwatches features significant updates to its health monitoring applications and its ability to capture recent conversations with Audio Intelligence.
The Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 both contain a new Health Sensing System powered by the S11 chip.

"The advanced sensor array helps you track a variety of metrics, turning every moment of your day into meaningful insights," said Deidre Caldbeck, Apple's Senior Director of Product Marketing for Apple Watch and Health, during Apple's product launch event on Wednesday. "These have a new sensing system that provides better skin contact during readings. It also supports better heart rate measurements during activity."

The system automatically takes background heartbeat ratings every five seconds, which is 60 times more frequently than the last generation of Apple Watches. HRV, a key indicator of stress and recovery, is now measured 24 times more often. The Health Sensing System also provides the user with a fresh fitness score every morning. This helps the user evaluate what they are safely capable of performing that day.
Apple has revamped its Health app as well.

"The Health app has a new insights tab where Apple Intelligence analyzes your health data," said Sumbul Desai, Apple's vice president of Health. "It also provides recommendations that dynamically adapt to you and your health level."
Users can upload results from blood work into the app to help it provide a more thorough health assessment. The new Health app is slated for release later this year.

The new Apple Watches also feature what the Cupertino company has named Audio Intelligence. This includes Live Rewind. This feature can transcribe the last 15 seconds of audio into a text presentation for the user. These snippets can be viewed immediately or saved for later reference.

"Now you can use Live Rewind to go back in time for 15 seconds to review a transcription of what was just said," said Ron Huang, vice president of Sensing and Connectivity at Apple. "This is great for trying to remember book recommendations or a colleague's great idea."
There is Siri Recap as well. This utilizes ambient listening by the phone to generate notes from conversations. These notes can be reviewed in the Siri app.
The Apple Watch Series 12 starts at $399 and is available for pre-ordering today with availability starting September 18.
The Apple Watch Ultra 4 has the same new features and the S11 chip. It starts at $799.
"The Ultra 4 is the ultimate sports and adventure watch," Caldbeck said. "It now gets over two days of battery life, which is enough time to conquer a 100-mile race."
AirPods 5 feature 50% better noise reduction
Apple introduced AirPods 5 on Wednesday, which feature improved noise cancellation capabilities and a longer battery life.

"Our beloved open-ear fit is redesigned from the inside for a more secure fit and richer, more detailed sound across a wider range of ear geometries," said Dave Pakkula, Apple's vice president of product design. "It creates a surround sound effect with 50% more noise reduction than the AirPods 4."

It also features a more natural Transparency mode, which allows the user to hear voices and sounds. The AirPods can automatically adjust between Active Noise Cancellation and Transparency. They have Live Translation as well, which Apple introduced last fall.
AirPods 5 sell for $129 and are available on September 18.
Apple revealed AirPods 5 with a wireless charging case for $149. These come with a wireless charging case, five hours of battery life with ANC, and an on-stem volume control.
